instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Open the billing page of one purchase, where the buyer can change or cancel it, and show the card that pays it", and give it subscription_id, return_url and subject_email (the signed-in buyer's verified email).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:open-the-billing-page-for-one-purchase-and-show-the-card and its input (the worked examples show two).

3. The purchase must belong to subject_email, or the tool refuses and opens nothing. Read what comes back: the redirect address is where the buyer goes to confirm the change on Stripe's page, and card is the card that pays (brand, last four, expiry only).
